verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an identity and auth platform, so asynchronous human approval for agent transactions is a fair axis. The pack documents only adjacent features: OAuth Device Authorization Flow for CLI login, MFA enrollment, and MCP server authorization. None of these is a CIBA-style or out-of-band approval step that gates an agent's sensitive transaction.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require asynchronous human approval (e.g. CIBA-style confirmation) before an autonomous agent completes a sensitive transaction
